risk_summary: The disclosure is generally detailed and quantitatively supported, but includes substantial standard forward-looking-risk boilerplate and judgment-based impairment language. Operating performance weakened materially in 2022, with lower sales, earnings, defense gross profit, supply-chain disruptions, labor shortages, and goodwill/intangible impairments. The absence of debt and stated cash resources provide some mitigation, although reliance on estimates and broad risk factors limits precision regarding future outcomes.
